اعتصما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَمَا (iʕtaṣamā) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اُعْتُصِمَا (uʕtuṣimā) /uʕ.tu.sˤi.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اِعْتَصِمَا (iʕtaṣimā) /iʕ.ta.sˤi.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
